name: Mosslax
biography: Kourtinacissus rochalizo. A gargantuan, deceptively placid mound of mossy plant matter that lures creatures close with inviting vines — then crushes and devours anything it can reach, weapons included. Habitat: Forest & Plains.

features.name: Inviting Vines
features.description: The plant life surrounding the mosslax inhibits creatures moving away from it. Creatures of the mosslax's choice within 60 feet of it must expend 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot moved away from the mosslax while on the ground.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The mosslax makes two Crushing Arm attacks.

features.name: Crushing Arm
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is Grappled (escape DC 20) by one of two arms.

features.name: Body Slam
features.description:
The mosslax leaps into the air and lands in a space within 20 feet of it, attempting to crush anything beneath it. Saving Throw: DC 20 Dexterity, each creature in the mosslax's destination space. Failure: 39 (6d12) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is knocked Prone, is Restrained, and unable to breathe until it no longer shares a space with the mosslax. Success: The target escapes and moves to the nearest unoccupied space within 5 feet of the mosslax.

A creature can take an action to make a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check, freeing itself or another creature trapped under the mosslax within its reach on a success.

features.name: Eat Anything
features.description: Trigger: A creature within 10 feet of the mosslax attacks it with a melee weapon. Response — Saving Throw: DC 20 Strength, the triggering creature. Failure: The target is disarmed, and the mosslax eats its weapon. If the weapon is nonmagical, the mosslax regains 11 (1d8 + 7) Hit Points and the weapon is destroyed.
